tagline: A leading international owner of container ships
hero_kpi_rationale: The key KPI for Costamare is fleet capacity in containers (TEU), as this is the primary revenue driver in maritime transport. Unlike technology companies focused on AI or cloud, fleet size and efficiency define competitive positioning.

kpis.name: Fleet Capacity (TEU)
kpis.explanation: Total number of 20-foot equivalent container units (TEU) the fleet can transport.
kpis.description: The fleet comprises large, modern, fuel-efficient vessels.
kpis.signal: Large fleet positioned in long-haul routes

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue generated from ship lease contracts.
kpis.description: Revenue growing driven by long-term contracts signed at favorable levels.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by elevated freight rates

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: High margin thanks to efficient operating and financing cost management.
kpis.signal: Very strong margin, benefiting from fixed-rate contracts

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.description: Lean headcount as operations are outsourced to technical managers.
kpis.signal: Light structure typical of a fleet management company

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending for acquisition of new vessels or improvements.
kpis.description: Limited CAPEX in 2025, primarily for maintenance and environmental compliance.

kpis.name: Long-term Contract Revenues
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue secured by lease contracts of more than 1 year.
kpis.description: Majority of vessels under long-term contracts, reducing exposure to spot market fluctuations.

kpis.name: Fleet Capacity (TEU)
kpis.explanation: Total number of 20-foot equivalent container units (TEU) the fleet can transport.
kpis.description: Fleet capacity maintained stable in 2025, with progressive fleet modernization.

ai_positioning.summary: Costamare makes no mention of AI-related initiatives in its reports. The company focuses on traditional container fleet management without signals of AI technology adoption.
evidence: No mention of AI or advanced automation in 2025 20-F
No references to AI-powered optimization tools
Absence of partnerships or innovative technology projects
